name: Question 2
problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14096165/assets/af3a9e323fa460b60bfa900c7edbcceb4057c442803160b2b4b5bd0704b4db7c.png)

Describe the set of points shown above using set-builder notation.

$$
{(x,y)\in {{field-1}}\,:\,{{field-2}}\le x\le {{field-3}},\,{{field-4}}\le y\le {{field-5}}}
$$
worked_solution:
Since all points $P(x,y)$ in our set lie at integer values of $x$ and $y,$ we have $x\in Z,y\in Z,$ and therefore 

$$
(x,y)\in Z\times Z={Z}^{2}.
$$

The points $P(x,y)$ satisfy the condition

$$
x\in {-1,0,1,2},\,y\in {-2,-1,0,1,2,3}.
$$

In other words,

$$
-1\le x\le 2,\,-2\le y\le 3.
$$

Therefore, we can write our set as follows:

$$
{(x,y)\in {Z}^{2}\,:\,-1\le x\le 2,\,-2\le y\le 3}
$$
